title.en: Transfer of Responsibility/Authority of Implementation of the National Soybean Development Program to the Ndc
title.orig: Transfer of Responsibility/Authority of Implementation of the National Soybean Development Program to the Ndc

text.en:
The responsibility and authority for formulating and implementing the National Soybean Development
Program (NSDP) is hereby transferred to the National Development Company.

All government agencies concerned are hereby directed to extend their full assistance and support to
NDC for the formulation and implementation of the program.

The National Development Company shall, in coordination with ministries and agencies concerned,
formulate and restructure the program and shall develop the necessary policies, guidelines, and implementing
regulations for the administration and control of the NSDP. The program, which shall include the funding
requirements, shall be submitted for the approval of the President within ninety (90) days after the effectivity
of this Executive Order.

The Ministry of Budget is hereby directed to allot and disburse funds required for the program's
implementation in accordance with the approval of the President referred to in Section 3 hereof.

NDC is authorized, subject to the approval of the President, to contract phases of the development
program to other agencies of government or the private sector.

All Decrees, Letters of Instruction or Implementation, Circulars, Orders, Rules and Regulations or
parts thereof that are inconsistent herewith are hereby revoked or modified accordingly.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-one.
